paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.
model_annotation: This bar chart compares the number of floating-point operations (# FLOPs) for different fine-tuning methods for language models using QAdapter. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with "Full FT", "TAG Adapter", "MTL-FT", "QAdapter", and "Ours", in that order. The vertical axis represents # FLOPs, with a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^18 to 10^20, with tick labels at each order of magnitude. The bars are colored orange, except for the last category, "Ours", which is green. The bar heights vary, with "Full FT" having the tallest bar at approximately 5 x 10^19 # FLOPs, and "Ours" having the shortest bar at around 1.5 x 10^18 # FLOPs; the other bars have values of approximately 2 x 10^19 for "TAG Adapter", 1.2 x 10^19 for "MTL-FT", and 4 x 10^18 for "QAdapter". The bars are not sorted by height, but rather follow the order of the categories on the horizontal axis, with no bars visually emphasized or annotated.
